name: 51913-sharegpt-35ba3b-dflash-2gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, with z-lab/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash as the speculative drafter.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, single node -- ~72 GB of target weights plus a 0.77 GB drafter do not leave one 80 GB H100 room for its caches, so two cards are the smallest topology that holds this model.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, 200 warmup requests then 60 measured, safety cap 3600 s. Budget ~15-25 min of traffic plus the weight load.
workload: ShareGPT V3 unfiltered cleaned split, 60 single-turn prompts, every request forced to exactly 300 output tokens with EOS ignored, greedy decoding (temperature 0), `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied. Materialised as `configs/data/sharegpt-60-out300-qwen36.jsonl`, regenerable with `configs/data/make-dataset.py`.
purpose: A conversational assistant with a draft model, answering one chat prompt at a time with 300-token replies on two GPUs.
launch:
# HAZARD: this file is read by a flat line reader that SKIPS every indented line, so a
# structured value must stay on ONE line as inline JSON. A block mapping arrives as an
# empty value, the engine starts without the key, and the run completes at rc=0.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 2
speculative-config: {"model": "z-lab/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash", "method": "dflash", "num_speculative_tokens": 8}
max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
